title: 第27章 深入洞府第28章 彼岸邪尊
content_zh:
听了洛红颜的分析，长卿的表情也凝重起来。
他对这个世界的修士实力并没有一个特别具体的概念，毕竟他太过弱小，仅仅是个最低等的倏忽二转。
和洛红颜比起来他已经算是蝼蚁了，能让洛红颜如此吃惊的实力，他觉得这血法修士的实力只怕是要强于柳露的。
“你觉得，对方大概是什么修为，起码是转瞬吧，估计能有转瞬几转？”
“转瞬？你在开玩笑么？”
洛红颜白了长卿一眼，“我虽然没见过真正的血法修士，不知道他们的生命力和血气照比同境界的其他修士能强多少。”
“但是转瞬，绝对不可能，即使是转瞬九转，还是最精于体魄修行的战法修士，被抽取那么多的血气，也会瞬间变成干尸。”
“你不要只见过一个柳露是转瞬修为，就觉得转瞬修士有那么厉害，仅仅是转瞬修士不可能有此等伟力。”
洛红颜笃定的语气和批评的口吻像个教育学生的班主任。
让长卿想起来以前上高中的时候他忙着做题，不好好吃饭，不好好睡觉的时候，叶清荷就会用这种语气数落他。
“你别以为你现在年轻就没事哈，把肠胃和眼睛都熬坏了，以后有你哭的时候。”
长卿发育的比同龄人晚些，那时叶清荷比他还高了一点，真有点大姐姐的感觉。
想到此处，长卿不禁嘴角微微上扬。
不明所以的洛红颜大感无语，“你怕不是有什么毛病，这时候笑什么。”
“没什么。”
“那你下次别笑的莫名其妙行么，你这人怪死了，时而聪明时而憨傻，在这么一个诡异的地方，你突然一笑，我心里都发毛。”
“抱歉抱歉，下次注意。”
“说回来，我建议还是别再继续深入探查了，如果柳露囚禁了这种级别的强者，那可是一条困龙啊，我们两个就算找到了其人，又有什么用呢。对人家来说，我俩就是蝼蚁而已。”
长卿却摇摇头。
“既然对方落难了，那他的目标就一定也是逃出去，我们目标一致，就有合作的可能。”

洛红颜嗤之以鼻。
“那种级别的强者，人家凭什么跟你合作。”
“不合作也可以利用，都是一样的。”
他的话让洛红颜一转头，只见长卿面无表情，语气平淡。
“有困难就会有需求，有弱点，需求和弱点兼备，就可以利用。”
“你不会也在利用我吧。”
“怎么会。”
长卿面无表情的脸转向洛红颜，转而浮现出一抹笑意，但是突然想到她不让自己突然笑出来，忙收敛起来，认真道。
“我们是合作，不是利用，我永远不会利用你，发生任何危险，我都会保护你。”
“你你你，你闭嘴哈，说话一点不知道害臊。”
洛红颜不知道是不是因为害羞，不再理会长卿，快走了几步，到了那个肉球蛇团跟前。
怕出现什么意外，长卿连忙跟上。
“娘。”
见到长卿过来，那蛇团有些兴奋，一根根触手都颤抖起来。
“话说这灵胚为什么会叫我娘，它把我认成柳露了么？”
洛红颜摇摇头。
“别试图用我们的想法去理解灵胚，它只是一团有生命的血肉，不一定具有正常的思维，没有五脏六腑，也没有六观六感，认知世界的方式和我们不一样。也许在它眼里，你和柳露有什么相同之处。”
content_en:
After listening to Luo Hongyan's analysis, Changqing's expression became serious.
He does not have a particularly specific concept of the strength of monks in this world. After all, he is too weak and is just the lowest level of Sudden Second Transformation.
Compared with Luo Hongyan, he was already an ant. With his strength that could surprise Luo Hongyan, he felt that this blood magic monk was probably stronger than Liu Lu.
"What kind of cultivation do you think the other party has? At least it can be a blink of an eye, and it can probably be a few blinks?"
"In a blink of an eye? Are you kidding me?"
Luo Hongyan rolled her eyes at Chang Qing, "Although I have never seen a real blood magic monk, I don't know how much stronger their vitality and blood energy are compared to other monks in the same realm."
"But it's absolutely impossible in a blink of an eye. Even if you turn nine in a blink of an eye, you are still the most proficient in physical cultivation of the combat monks. If so much blood is extracted, you will instantly turn into a mummy."
"Don't think that just because you have seen a Liu Lu with the Shuangshu cultivation level, you think that Shunshuan cultivators are that powerful. It is impossible for a mere Shunshuan cultivator to have such great power."
Luo Hongyan's determined tone and critical tone were like a class teacher educating students.
It reminded Chang Qing that when he was in high school and he was busy doing questions and didn't eat or sleep well, Ye Qinghe would scold him in this tone.
"Don't think that you'll be fine now that you're young. It'll hurt your stomach and eyes. You'll cry sometimes in the future."
Changqing developed later than his peers. At that time, Ye Qinghe was a little taller than him, and she really felt like a big sister.
Thinking of this, Chang Qing couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth slightly.
Luo Hongyan, who didn't understand why, was speechless, "I'm afraid there's something wrong with you, why are you laughing at this time?"
"Nothing."
"Then don't laugh out of nowhere next time. You're such a weird person. Sometimes you're smart and sometimes you're stupid. In such a weird place, when you suddenly smile, it makes me feel scared."
"Sorry, sorry, please be careful next time."
"Having said that, I suggest you not continue to investigate further. If Liu Lu imprisons a powerful person of this level, he is a trapped dragon. Even if the two of us find him, what's the use. To others, we are just ants."
Chang Qing shook his head.
"Since the other party is in trouble, his goal must be to escape. If we have the same goal, there is the possibility of cooperation."
Luo Hongyan sneered.
"For a strong man of that level, why should anyone cooperate with you?"
"You can also take advantage if you don't cooperate. It's the same thing."
His words made Luo Hongyan turn her head and saw Changqing's expressionless face and calm tone.
"When there are difficulties, there will be needs. If there are weaknesses, if you have both needs and weaknesses, you can take advantage of them."
"You're not using me too, are you?"
"How come?"
Changqing's expressionless face turned to Luo Hongyan, and a smile appeared, but suddenly he thought of her not to let him laugh suddenly, so he quickly restrained himself and said seriously.
"We are cooperating, not taking advantage. I will never take advantage of you. If any danger occurs, I will protect you."
"You, you, you, shut up, you are not ashamed to speak."
Luo Hongyan didn't know whether it was because of shyness, so she ignored Chang Qing and walked a few steps quickly to reach the meat ball snake ball.
Afraid of any accident, Chang Qing hurriedly followed.
"Mother."
Seeing Chang Qing coming, the snake group was a little excited, and all its tentacles trembled.
"By the way, why did this spiritual embryo call me mother? Did it recognize me as Liu Lu?"
Luo Hongyan shook her head.
"Don't try to use our ideas to understand the spiritual embryo. It is just a ball of living flesh and blood. It may not have normal thinking. It has no internal organs or six senses. The way it perceives the world is different from ours. Maybe in its eyes, you and Liu Lu have something in common."
